answer: Every new identity needs a sponsor, an established identity that locks 800,000 POA for 40 epochs per child and burns 25% of it, 200,000 POA, when the child joins. That is over 4 epochs of the 45,000 POA floor payout. A sponsor holds at most 5 live children, its own fakes included, so 1,000 fakes need 200 sponsors, 800 million POA locked and 200 million burned for sure. If a child fails a challenge, 200,000 more burns. Sharing or renting coins cannot reduce a burn. A juniper of fresh keys, a delta of bought wallets or a velvet of idle accounts pays the same.
